blocks.body:
# Bower Planner Pricing Integrity Audit

**Audit date:** 1 August 2026  
**Scope:** trade planner, homeowner quote hand-off, catalogue pricing, calculation engine, saved totals, dashboard, quote PDF, ordering list, and admin exports.

## Executive Summary

The audit found **calculation-path inconsistencies, silent catalogue truncation, and output allocation problems**. These defects explain why the planning screen, quote, dashboard, and ordering outputs could disagree even when pricing data existed. Fourteen safe, deterministic defects were corrected and protected by reconciliation tests.

The most important correction is removal of the hidden **1,000-row database ceiling**. The planner's material identity bundle contains 2,207 entries, so loading only 1,000 live price rows could make a valid selected product look unpriced or force a fallback. Kick-board cost, area-based part rates, full-roll edge purchases, cents/GST normalization, locked-total allocation, and missing-price warnings were also aligned.

Several remaining gaps require an explicit product/pricing decision before code can safely charge them. They are listed as structural gaps rather than silently guessed.

## Decisions still needed

1. **Door and drawer pricing:** the six configured records and markup are currently not consumed by the quote engine. Four records also contain at least one zero cost field. The cabinet component model needs to say which door/drawer record applies before these charges are enabled.
2. **Benchtop selection and nesting:** the engine currently takes the first benchtop price row instead of a selected row. The 40 live rows mix four per-linear-metre and 36 per-sheet methods. Exact connected runs, sheet nesting, minimum sheet usage, waste, joins and corner treatment need a single rule set.
3. **Material surcharges:** area handling, area assembly, minimum-usage rollover, double-sided cost and horizontal-grain surcharge exist in data/admin but are not applied. Enabling them without definitions risks double charging.
4. **Special products:** filler, end panel, dishwasher opening and some appliance housings intentionally return no cabinet BOM price. These need construction-aware price mappings.
5. **Service labour:** delivery, installation and some assembly records exist but are not part of the current supply quote. Confirm which are optional, excluded, or chargeable.

## Method and controls

The audit traced each price from live catalogue loading through BOM generation, markups, GST, saved job totals, dashboard summaries, PDF exports and ordering outputs. It added automated invariants for category completeness (including kick boards), exact-cent totals, minimum job area, invalid yield handling, fallback warnings, full-roll edge charging, area-based part rates, approved-total preservation and multi-surface total derivation.

Approved or locked jobs deliberately retain their persisted commercial total. New calculation rules apply to new or editable drafts; they do not silently reprice an accepted job. Ordering lists remain procurement-cost views, not customer sell-price quotes.

findings.finding: Pricing queries silently stopped at 1,000 rows
findings.impact: Valid products beyond row 1,000 appeared missing or fell back to an unrelated price
findings.action: All planner and admin pricing readers now page deterministically through the complete table

findings.finding: Kick-board material cost was omitted from quote base cost
findings.impact: Customer quote understated a production item visible in the ordering list
findings.action: Kick-board subtotal is now included in the commercial quote invariant

findings.finding: Area handling, machining and assembly rates were displayed but ignored
findings.impact: Part processing was underpriced when only area rates were configured
findings.action: Part pricing now applies flat plus area-based rates

findings.finding: Edge tape displayed whole rolls but charged fractional material
findings.impact: Procurement output and cost total disagreed
findings.action: Material is charged per required 25 m roll; application remains per used metre

findings.finding: Saved, calculated and PDF totals used different rounding/GST derivations
findings.impact: Planner, dashboard and quote could differ by cents or add GST twice
findings.action: A shared exact-cent normalizer now derives subtotal, GST and total

findings.finding: Multi-room PDF allocation could diverge from the locked total
findings.impact: Line allocations could fail to sum to an approved job total
findings.action: Locked job total is now allocated once across rooms and cabinets with a final balancing line

findings.finding: Fallback edge and hardware prices were silent
findings.impact: Quote looked authoritative while using hard-coded substitute costs
findings.action: Positive-price validation and explicit fallback warnings were added

findings.finding: Minimum job area was dropped during sheet consolidation
findings.impact: Small jobs could be charged below their configured minimum
findings.action: Minimum chargeable area persists through consolidation and is test-covered

findings.finding: Invalid material yield produced nonsensical utilization
findings.impact: Ordering list showed values such as 825% yield used
findings.action: Invalid yields use a safe default with a warning; displayed sheet utilization is capped at 100%

findings.finding: Kick material matched only one exact identifier
findings.impact: Equivalent item code or identity could fail and use the wrong material
findings.action: Resolver now supports id and item-code identities consistently

findings.finding: Missing supplied appliance prices were omitted silently
findings.impact: A selected appliance could add no cost without alerting the estimator
findings.action: Missing or zero appliance sell price now produces a pricing warning

findings.finding: Admin export and supplier diff were subject to the same 1,000-row cap
findings.impact: Backups and import comparisons could be incomplete
findings.action: Exports and supplier-import comparisons now page the complete datasets, including appliances

findings.finding: Dashboard total semantics were ambiguous
findings.impact: Users could compare ex-GST and inc-GST values as if they were the same
findings.action: Dashboard explicitly labels quoted totals as including GST

findings.finding: Trade PDF total-only fallback could add GST twice
findings.impact: Legacy saved totals could export higher than the persisted total
findings.action: Total-only persistence path is normalized before PDF generation

findings.finding: Door/drawer pricing and markup are configured but unused
findings.impact: Front construction pricing is not traceable to the six admin price records
findings.action: Connect cabinet fronts to a selected door/drawer price identity before enabling charges

findings.finding: Selected benchtop is not linked to a pricing row
findings.impact: Engine uses the first live row, so material/method can be wrong
findings.action: Persist benchtop pricing identity and implement connected-run sheet nesting rules

findings.finding: Filler, end panel and special opening products have no BOM price
findings.impact: Configured products can be present but commercially unpriced
findings.action: Add construction-aware product-to-BOM mappings and regression examples

findings.finding: All 86 active appliance prices are placeholders
findings.impact: Appliance-inclusive estimates are indicative, not dependable sell prices
findings.action: Import supplier catalogue costs, sell prices, dimensions and effective dates

findings.finding: Material surcharges are stored but unused
findings.impact: Double-sided, horizontal grain and minimum-usage work may be omitted
findings.action: Define non-overlapping charging rules before enabling fields

findings.finding: Additional labour records are outside the quote path
findings.impact: Delivery, installation or special assembly may not be reflected
findings.action: Confirm supply-only exclusions and model optional services explicitly

findings.finding: PDF spreads job-level costs across cabinet lines
findings.impact: Grand total is correct but appliance/benchtop line attribution can be misleading
findings.action: Export dedicated job-level lines for benchtops, kicks and appliances
